## Why it matters

The Frankfurt collections portal provides access to digitized special holdings including rare prints, manuscripts, newspapers, photographs, and estate materials.

It is useful for German historical research because it concentrates heterogeneous library and archival source types in one place, even though the site currently limits automated access.
